stock_master.query: SELECT ItemCode, Description, UOM, Barcode, ItemGroup, ItemBrand, ItemCategory, ItemClass, IsActive, StockControl, LastModified FROM dbo.vw_AutoCountStockMaster;

stock_balance.query: SELECT AsAtDate, ItemCode, Location, UOM, BalanceQty, SmallestBalQty, UnitCost, CostValue FROM dbo.vw_AutoCountStockBalance WHERE AsAtDate = CAST(? AS date);

stock_movement.query: SELECT DocType, DocNo, DocDate, ItemCode, Location, BatchNo, UOM, QtyIn, QtyOut, UnitCost, SourceTable, LastModified FROM dbo.vw_AutoCountStockMovement WHERE DocDate >= CAST(? AS datetime2) AND DocDate < CAST(? AS datetime2);

stock_documents.query: SELECT DocType, DocNo, DocDate, Cancelled, FromLocation, ToLocation, ItemCode, Location, UOM, Qty, UnitCost, RefDocNo, LastModified FROM dbo.vw_AutoCountStockDocuments WHERE DocDate >= CAST(? AS datetime2) AND DocDate < CAST(? AS datetime2);
